initial_market: Canadian business operators selling paid API work
first_agent_protocol: x402; adapter not implemented or certified

partners.name: Peoples Group
partners.reason: First institution to evaluate for CAD EFT, Interac and safeguarded customer funds. Keep the bank agreement and settlement evidence separate from the application ledger.
partners.condition: Confirm program eligibility, trust structure, API access, returns, pricing and stablecoin-related restrictions. USD access requires its own approved account and agreement.

partners.name: Circle Mint
partners.reason: Evaluate direct institutional mint and redemption access to USDC. Circle lists Canadian bank domiciles for supported wires; this does not establish account approval.
partners.condition: Institutional eligibility and KYB approval come first. Base Sepolia is the test network; mainnet asset, receiver, signer, RPC and finality must be enrolled separately.

partners.name: Brale
partners.reason: First issuer provider to evaluate for a branded USD token with reserves, redemption and custody operated by a legal issuer. Hellabit would supply the brand and product, not claim to be the issuer of record.
partners.condition: Canadian distribution eligibility is unconfirmed. Published issuance starts at $1,000/month; total program costs and approval require a quote. Activate only when demand can support those costs.
partners.enquiry_delivery_note: DNSSEC validation failed for mail delivery; owner BCC delivered; no duplicate submitted.

alternatives.name: M0 with a non-Stripe issuer
alternatives.condition: Issuer and jurisdiction approval, commercial costs and custody arrangements are unresolved. Do not select Bridge. Do not claim a Hellabit token is an M0 extension without implementing and verifying that integration.

distribution.name: x402
distribution.decision: Prefer an open protocol and self-operated verification/settlement when the operating role and economics are approved; no protocol compatibility claim for the custom router.

activation_order: Sell the paid-API workflow and validate contribution economics
Approve one bank or direct USDC settlement binding
Prove a bounded real settlement and refund journey
Add branded issuance after issuer approval and demonstrated demand
not_authorized_by_this_plan: publishing or representing a provider as an approved partner
shared_foundation_blocker: An approved operating entity and partner program, with exact settlement authority and independent readback. No provider enrollment exists in this build.
